gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with a new probable diagnosis of glioblastoma based on MRI imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: The evaluation of PET imaging using PET ligand [18F]JNJ-64413739 or a [18F] labeled equivalent in vivo in patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: prior to initiation of specific tumor therapy and prior to any surgery (including biopsy)

role_evidence.quote: The evaluation of PET imaging using PET ligand [18F]JNJ-64413739 or a [18F] labeled equivalent in vivo in patients.

coder_notes: Imaging-only proof-of-principle study; the only agent is a diagnostic PET tracer. No antitumour treatment is part of the trial. Phase NA in the registry. P2X7 receptor expression is imaged (microglia) but is not a tumour molecular biomarker for selection, so no biomarker row.
